candidate.rationale: Next untried candidate after inspecting the complete captured common context, route, review and evaluation records: keep the baseline physical settings and enable only the protocol-proved exact signed 18-bit reduction with sign extension to 32 bits and unchanged cycle contract. Candidate 1 used both RTL actions at these settings: cell_area_um2=160081 versus baseline 161954, setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439 versus +0.19292, hold_slack_ns=0.0945523, and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations. Its physical_qualified and rank_eligible flags are false, failure_classes are physical_execution and timing, and energy_j is empty; its approximately 1.16 percent cell-area decrease does not establish a qualified Q improvement. The prior review approved proposal correctness and domain compliance before EDA; it did not establish physical closure. Removing request-qualified isolation avoids its extra input gating and associated load while retaining the width-reduction opportunity for arithmetic area and capacitance. This may recover setup margin but forfeits suppression of idle multiplier switching. The captured report has no critical-path breakdown, so isolation is not established as the cause of the timing failure, and neither timing recovery nor energy improvement is claimed. Keep utilization=40 and density=0.55 because the baseline closed under those placement conditions; abc_area=0 avoids introducing an area-oriented synthesis tradeoff with limited setup headroom; repair_margin=0 is retained because neither captured run reports electrical violations. The full physical/action tuple is unseen, with one new evaluation captured out of the three-candidate limit and continue_search=true. Historical candidate-1 costs remain physical_wall_seconds=3309.008427424007 and postprocess_wall_seconds=3.4301774576306343e-7, total_wall_seconds=3309.008427767025, with elapsed_search_seconds=3431.9686764859944 reported separately; do not treat that elapsed value as remaining agent budget or discard failure costs. Rank only physically and measurement-qualified results using Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6), seeking Q<1.0 and then Q<=0.98. Required protected evaluation fields are physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, all three energy_j values, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical_manifest and wall-time costs. Die area is not a scoring input. Energy interpretation remains limited to Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route workload activity plus extracted SPEF, with the frozen completion windows; no glitch-aware or silicon-energy claim is made. Preserve the failed result and costs and retain the best qualified result, currently the baseline at Q=1.0. Proposal validation is not an EDA measurement.
